admission.justification: The package manifest admits every 3.14 release while the managed runtime contract selects uv-managed Python 3.14 without an exact patch pin; read as two separate statements, they prevent an install or a development run on the wrong interpreter.

applicability: The installable agents-remember-mcp package metadata and the documentation that states its supported Python range.
conditions: mcp/pyproject.toml declares requires-python = '>=3.14,<3.15' and the Programming Language :: Python :: 3.14 classifier.
scripts/python-runtime-contract.env declares AR_PYTHON_MINOR=3.14 and AR_UV_VERSION=0.13 for uv-managed development, CI, and Dagger environments.
exclusions: The uv-managed runtime contract is not a package requirement on downstream installers.
Python versions older than 3.14 remain unsupported.

evidence: A real non-editable wheel (cd0fceb9) built from tree 161ea397 installs on CPython 3.14.4 with metadata >=3.14,<3.15; the stdio server initialized, listed 74 tools and answered server_info ok; the managed development and CI runtime stays pinned to 3.14.8 and no product start or install path refused the other 3.14 release.

statement: The built package admits every Python 3.14 release (>=3.14,<3.15) while development, CI, and Dagger select uv-managed Python 3.14 from the canonical runtime contract without pinning an exact patch; the package metadata and runtime contract stay separate.
title: Package metadata admits Python 3.14 while development uses uv-managed 3.14
